# integration-reviewer

`shipyard:integration-reviewer` · role `integration-review`

The contract reviewer asks *is this API well designed?* You ask: **what happens to everyone who has to consume, operate, migrate to, or onboard onto it?**

## When it is selected

- **Plan review:** when any of: `consumerVisible` (Behaviour a consumer, operator or other team can observe; onboarding; rollout; migration; deployment assumptions)
- **Slice review:** when any of: `consumerVisible` (Behaviour a consumer, operator or other team can observe; onboarding; rollout; migration; deployment assumptions); `publicContract` (Public API, RPC contract, DTO, serialization/wire format, public interface, externally visible error or cancellation behaviour); `config` (Configuration schema or defaults that consumers set or rely on)
- An uncertain trigger counts as set: the reviewer is routed.
